body:
How an integration carrier (combo item) closes under evaluation, learned 2026-11-10 (Opus2; w-b785 done 3/3, w-9219 crit 3 failed).
1) The evaluator needs the claim's NAMED root to have a passing, eligible, REGISTERED committed-input run at that root's current HEAD. The DL560 FULL on the test ref does not count: same tree, but a different commit and claim.
   Cheapest route, no cargo slot: in the named root, run `cd ui && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` (15-35 s; ui/node_modules is ignored, so the root stays clean). Then, from Claude in one call:
     pushd "<root>" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- node ui/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p ui
   The host notice says "not a recognized test runner; no Test record will follow", but the run is TRACKED and eligible, and the evaluation request was ADMITTED (w-b785, w-9219).
   Do NOT use direct `node vitest.mjs`: it has no verification kind, so the request is refused with verification_record_unclassified_stages (w-6e810a28b300).
2) The install criterion must be written in the PAST tense: "was installed ... a later landing's install may since have replaced it, in which case this binary is kept aside there".
   The present-tense "is installed" FAILS once the next landing installs over it: w-9219 failed on this after combo42's install.
   Otherwise, evaluate and complete each carrier BEFORE the next landing's install.
3) Order: holder notes for each criterion -> registered run in the named root -> termal_evaluate_acceptance in a LATER turn (criterionEvidence locators allowed) -> done with landing {commit, remote, branch, pushed_at}.
   Re-name the root (termal_name_source_root) whenever a host notice says runtime_observation_scope_changed for that item.
